note: No public API tracks developer-organization country or approved-vendor-family status as structured data. This registry is manually maintained and manually reviewed, not synced. developer_country is the country of the DEVELOPING ORGANIZATION's headquarters (derived from published model cards and org HQ) — it is a company-domicile proxy, not a claim about where the actual training or development work took place. A 'developer-organization country only' governance requirement should be defined against this field explicitly, since it is not the same claim as 'this model was developed in country X'. verified_at should be updated whenever an entry is re-checked, not just when it's first added.
